claims: Insolvent describes a person or organization unable to pay debts as they fall due.
Insolvent describes a person or organization when total liabilities exceed total assets.
Cash-flow insolvency means unable to pay debts when due.
Balance-sheet insolvency means liabilities outweigh assets.
In certain jurisdictions like the US, if a taxpayer is insolvent, they may not be required to include forgiven debt in their income for tax purposes.
